modelingNotes: Camp North End: 1701 N. Graham Street — procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/clt-cne-1701-n-graham.ts

The original 1941–43 part of the Army Quartermaster Corps' Building No. 6, the easternmost of the depot's three south warehouses, between the railway and North Graham Street; the building's pre-1955 metal-sided extension north-east of it is `clt-cne-gama-goat`. A one-storey box 56 × 121 m, its brick painted pale grey, three corrugated-metal clerestory monitors across its width (the survey counts four on No. 6 before the extension), a loading platform under a canopy along the railway side, a dock recess and a lower wing on the street side, and storefronts under black steel canopies on the south-west end on Keswick Avenue.
Identity: the long pale-grey box with three silver monitors across its white roof.

Evidence: - OSM: the multipolygon relation/8793520 ("1701 N. Graham", height 9) and its 9 parts: monitors way/835812866, 835812868, 835842061 (height 9), the main roof 835812865, 835812867, 835812869, 835812872 (6.9), the street-side wing 835812871 (5.8), the railway platform 835812864 (1); and way/836225484 (height 1), an outer member of the relation also tagged building:part, the strip along the north-east end. - Lidar, USGS 3DEP NC Phase 4 Mecklenburg 2016, 1 m (measured, NAVD88): ground 227.9–228.7 (y = 0 is 227.9); deck 235.3 (7.4 m); monitors 238.1 (10.2 m); wing and platform canopy 234.0 (6.1 m). - C-M Historic Landmarks Commission survey report (2017, landmarkscommission.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Ford-Motor-Co-Plant-SR.pdf), Buildings Nos. 4–6 (published): the matched set, 180 ft wide, brick, corrugated-metal monitors across the width, four on No. 6, whose windows "have been covered over". - Mecklenburg County tax parcel 07903C99 (CAMP GAMA GOAT PROPERTY OWNER LP): built 1943, face brick. - Camp North End leasing brochure (2021, camp.nc): "1701 N. Graham Street", 75,000 sq ft. - Mapillary 360° photo 353699656976831 (cbreedlove, 2022-06-10, CC BY-SA 4.0), 31 m south of the south-west end: the end wall painted light grey over a white base, a flat parapet with a dark coping line, two storefronts under flat black canopies. - USGS NAIP orthophoto (public domain): white roofs.

Measured from the photo (its camera 20.4 m from the wall): the storefronts at 18–31 m and 46–50 m from the west corner. Estimated: the grey's exact value (one photo, partly in shade); window and canopy sizes on the south-west end; the long faces' openings, which no licensed photo shows (drawn as a few windows and the dock doors).
Frame and kit: `clt-cne-301-camp-road.ts`. y along the long axis (bearing 39.45°), placement bearing 39.45; origin at the outline's centroid, lng −80.8327981, lat 35.2447076.
